split.protocol: StratifiedGroupKFold 5-fold, groups defined by identical 10-feature vectors; fold 0 test, fold 1 validation, folds 2-4 training; no fold selection

preprocessing: train-only z-score numerical features; no target rescaling or oversampling
selection: User-directed exploratory confirmation of the previously observed near-marginal fixed-gain SGDM s2 (.03); no new hyperparameter search; not the validation-accuracy winner.
test_protocol: Refit on original outer_train (train+validation); test only at step 20000; same reused split and paired seeds as earlier ordinary and learned-gain controls; exploratory, not independent evidence.

reference.comparability: different published split/preprocessing/tuning; context only; no claim of exact reproduction

parameterization: gain * sqrt(out_features) * W / norm(W), gains frozen at exact initial values, biases unchanged
